summary.en: Switch between heliocentric and geocentric frames as Earth overtakes Mars.
summary.zh: 在地心与日心参考系间切换，观察地球超越火星时的视运动。

body.en: Earth completes its orbit faster. Near opposition it passes between the Sun and Mars.
body.zh: 地球公转更快；冲日前后，地球从太阳与火星之间超越而过。

body.en: In the Earth-centered frame, Mars traces a temporary loop. The planet never reverses its heliocentric velocity.
body.zh: 在地心系中，火星轨迹出现短暂回环；它在日心系中的速度从未真正反向。

title.zh: 同一太阳系，多种参考系

summary.en: Compare Sun-, Earth-, and Jupiter-centered descriptions of the same instant.
summary.zh: 对比同一时刻在日心、地心与木星中心坐标中的描述。

body.en: The broad architecture is simplest when the Sun is the origin.
body.zh: 以太阳为原点时，太阳系大尺度结构最简洁。

body.en: Changing frame changes coordinates and apparent paths, not the physical event.
body.zh: 切换参考系会改变坐标与视轨迹，但不会改变物理事件本身。

title.zh: 木星刻出的柯克伍德空隙

summary.en: Read resonances as missing density in semi-major-axis space.
summary.zh: 在半长轴分布中，把平均运动共振读成密度缺口。

body.en: Main-belt asteroids cluster in a–e space, but strong Jovian period ratios deplete narrow bands.
body.zh: 主带小行星在 a–e 空间聚集，但木星的强周期比共振清空了若干窄带。

title.en: Why Trojans gather at L4 and L5
title.zh: 特洛伊群为何聚集在 L4/L5

summary.en: Explore the rotating geometry around Jupiter's stable triangular points.
summary.zh: 探索木星轨道上稳定三角拉格朗日点周围的旋转几何。

body.en: L4 and L5 form equilateral configurations with the Sun and Jupiter in the circular restricted three-body model.
body.zh: 在圆型限制性三体模型中，L4、L5 与太阳、木星构成等边三角形。

summary.en: Atira, Aten, Apollo, and Amor are geometric orbit classes, not risk scores.
summary.zh: 阿提拉、阿登、阿波罗与阿莫尔是几何轨道分类，并非风险等级。

title.en: Classify by q, a, and Q

body.en: Filter the catalog and compare perihelion and aphelion distances with Earth's orbit.
body.zh: 筛选目录，并把近日点与远日点距离同地球轨道比较。

title.zh: 保护冥王星的 3:2 共振

summary.en: Pluto crosses Neptune's orbital radius without close encounters.
summary.zh: 冥王星虽穿过海王星的轨道半径，却通过共振避免近距离相遇。

body.en: For every two Pluto revolutions, Neptune completes about three. Their conjunction geometry remains protected.
body.zh: 冥王星每公转约两圈，海王星约完成三圈；二者的会合几何因此保持安全。

title.en: The road out: Voyager and beyond
title.zh: 离开太阳系：旅行者号之路

summary.en: Overlay teaching trajectories on the rare outer-planet alignment of the launch era.
summary.zh: 在发射时代罕见的外行星排列上叠加教学型航天器轨迹。

body.en: Jupiter and Saturn redirected Voyager's heliocentric velocity; the overlay is schematic and identifies its source separately.
body.zh: 木星与土星改变了旅行者号的日心速度；叠加轨迹是示意性的，并单独标注来源。
